newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Algeria's newly elected Assembly to sit in 10 days.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's newly elected Assembly to sit in 10 days.

text.p: Algeria's first multi-party National Assembly is required by law to meet 10 days from Friday, the day election results were announced.
At its first session the lower house will elect a Speaker.
Once it sits, the government of Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia will resign and President Liamine Zeroual will ask a parliament member to form a new government.
The new premier can choose cabinet members from inside or outside the lower house but he has to get Zeroual's approval on naming every minister.

He would then present his government's programme to the house for a confidence vote. If the government does not win the confidence vote, the designate prime minister steps down and Zeroual asks another member to form a cabinet.
These steps might change once an upper house is appointed by indirect voting later this year.
